name: Gralith Quillor
keeps: the checkpoint, and what it was taken over
does: Replays the chain from nothing and says whether the balance is the sum of the events. Signs when it is.
reason: Recited the Lord’s Prayer perfectly on the gallows, which was held to be impossible for a witch.
text: Gralith quillor of the turned key, keeps the book for the 7th tranche, doors 58 to 66. Keeps the checkpoint, and what it was taken over. Reads Rev. George Burroughs.
